row.name: Glaukos Corporation Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=27 breakdowns=2 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=0.44 tightness=0.85 base_volume_vs_leg=0.82 base_volume_vs_avg=0.92
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 27 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; 2 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 0.44 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -1.6% vs its 20-SMA, -7.1% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The mechanical grade is A (8.0) but three recorded check failures — C (27-session base with 2 breakdowns and 0.44 giveback), RE (burst bar only 88% of the prior 5-bar range), and VOL (volume rank 13 of 60, only 1.15x the 50-session average against a required 1.5x for a base over 21 sessions) — collectively drag this well below A quality. Visually the base region (Aug 21–Sep 29) shows a declining, wide-ranging consolidation with multiple overlapping red and green bars and a clear downward drift from the ~191 high toward ~155, confirming the loose, declining character the numbers flag. The signal bar itself is honest (closes near its high, no long tail), but it is launching from a deteriorating base into a trend that has already rolled over from its peak.
claude.key_risk: The base is a 27-session declining consolidation with two 4% breakdowns and nearly half the leg given back, meaning any follow-through faces the full weight of overhead supply from the Aug–Sep distribution zone above 175.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps below the signal day's close of 164.19 or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back under 162, confirming the base breakdown pattern continues.
